issue.title: Vault bob-navigation-hotkeys and task-status-cycler are stuck on protected dirty deploys from another checkout

task_type_fields.impact: Obsidian runs bob-navigation-hotkeys from before the bob-cli-dm Task Card theme work (14b4fda, 1c9e0e1, acd96d4, 21f2a0e, 2e1e881) and bob-cli-e2.5's daily-review label cleanup in 313-task-card-theme-projection.js, and runs task-status-cycler from before 68f0443 (complete-line api guard). Bryan does not get those shipped behaviors until the deploys are reconciled. The e2.5 change itself is dead-copy removal with no visible effect.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-e2.5 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, epic bob-cli-e2 phase plugin-mirror); triaged by the bob-cli-e2 land agent.

Root cause: the vault's bob-navigation-hotkeys and task-status-cycler deploys were made from a dirty bob-plugins checkout in another workspace (bob-cli_12's linked repo). `bob plugins sync` correctly refuses to overwrite another checkout's uncommitted deploy without --force (bob-cli-cu), so every later sync from master skips both plugins and they stay stale.

Repro (2026-10-29, bob-plugins master 06cda80):
1. `bob plugins list` -> bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.60.0 `drift`, deployed from uncommitted build at 25d864e (2026-10-28T23:14:09Z); task-status-cycler 1.42.2 `drift`, deployed from uncommitted build at 3c84ee3 (2026-10-28T20:15:59Z). Every other plugin is `synced`.
2. `~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/{bob-navigation-hotkeys,task-status-cycler}/.bob-deploy.json` record `"dirty": "dirty"` and a bob-cli_12 source_root.
3. bob-cli-e2.5's broad `bob plugins sync` protected both plugins and did not use --force.

Fix: confirm whether the bob-cli_12 bob-plugins checkout still holds uncommitted work that is not on master (its owning agent, or Bryan, decides). Once it is committed or abandoned, run `bob plugins sync` from a clean master checkout (--force only after that confirmation) and verify `bob plugins list` reports all 8 plugins `synced`.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-e2.5 proposed reconciling the protected deploys its plugins sync refused to overwrite; the bob-cli-e2 land agent confirmed both plugins still show drift against master.

payload.description: cu added the sync protection that refuses to overwrite another checkout's dirty deploy; that protection is why these two plugins stay stale
e2.5's plugin-mirror sync hit the protection and proposed this reconcile

evidence.note: Independent repro 2026-10-30 by bob-cli-e6 land agent (bob-plugins master 957f741): 'bob plugins sync --dry-run -n --repo <checkout>' reports 19 unchanged and refuses bob-navigation-hotkeys, deployed from an uncommitted bob-cli_16 build at a42de4d (2026-10-30T03:40:47Z, from bob-cli-e6.13 work). task-status-cycler is now synced. The deployed nav main.js is a strict subset of 74d6da2 (20-line diff: older 'Pomodoro themes' copy), so master includes it. bob-cli-e6.14 note #1 proposed the same fix. The bob-cli-e6 landing tale force-syncs nav-hotkeys from master after its own plugin changes.

payload.entry: Task-types landing deployed all five changed plugins from bob-cli workspace 16; bob plugins list with BOB_PLUGINS_DIR pointing to that checkout reports 8/8 synced. bob-navigation-hotkeys was force-synced as approved; no stale plugin deploys remain.
